exposure: Birth asphyxia (defined as 5 min Apgar<7 or those with no spontaneous respirations after birth)
outcome: Need for bag and mask ventilation
cohort: 125 neonates admitted to the NICU at a teaching hospital in Nepal from January 2013 to December 2013 with a diagnosis of birth asphyxia
finding: Birth asphyxia was one of the commonest causes of NICU admission, and babies with HIE Grade III had a very poor prognosis.
mod_finding: 22.4% of neonates were delivered via caesarean section.
gest_age: Term gestation associated with higher rate of birth asphyxia
